targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.status != 'SUCCESS' AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT COALESCE(r.error_type, 'UNKNOWN') as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.status != 'SUCCESS' AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY metric

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.error_type) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.error_type IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT p.name as value FROM proxies p JOIN proxy_requests pr ON p.device_id = pr.proxy_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp) AND pr.status != 'SUCCESS' AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT r.error_type as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.error_type IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as error_rate FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT p.name, p.device_id, p.location, COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as error_count, COUNT(*) as total_requests, COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as error_rate, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pr.error_type) as error_types FROM proxies p JOIN proxy_requests pr ON p.device_id = pr.proxy_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location HAVING error_count > 0 ORDER BY error_count DESC LIMIT 20

list.name: location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location FROM proxies WHERE location IS NOT NULL
